description: Reviewer 2 fairness control. Baseline joint training plus extra joint-training gradient steps equal to the Reptile arm's inner-loop spend (n_train_subjects * inner_steps * epochs when update_freq=0). Held-out slot stays at zero-init. If this arm does not match reptile_lora's accuracy, the meta-init gain is not merely a compute artefact. Runner: run_experiment.py --condition compute_matched.
